title: Inside a heated shower head.  (suicide shower)
summary: BigClive tears down a heated electric shower head of the type common in some countries, often called a suicide shower. He examines the construction and the dangerous fault conditions, such as poor insulation and missing earthing.
why: HN commenters cite it as a teardown from a YouTuber who dissects appliances, showing live wires in contact with water.

quote.text: Big Clive also did a teardown and analysis of them, including the fault conditions that would make it dangerous
